claim: *Task-driven traversal.* A task enters the modeling substrate through a named system entity and follows only the represented relationships required by its engineering question.

topology.description: Directed task entry to named entity; equal unordered relation peers accessible selectively.

required_terms: Named entity A job or a service
Retrieve only the relations needed for the current question; no prescribed traversal order.
bw_encoding: Only the named entry entity uses 8%; six relation surfaces remain white and equal.
redesign: Only the named entry entity uses 8%; six relation surfaces remain white and equal. Exception: radial entity-to-relation spokes show no prescribed traversal order, as the source footer explicitly states.
alt: A task enters through a named system entity. Connections fan out to six peer relationships: service registry, flow model, lifecycle, policy, provenance and measurements. The task retrieves only relationships needed for its question.
